Runtime Railway volume markers prove attachment/mount intent for a container start, not state survival across redeploys.
CI success does not prove hosted six-worker execution or hosted trading acceptance.
Held-out gate infrastructure does not prove a real quality win until an actual frozen campaign is graded.
ONNX code validation does not prove production image size until a real production build is measured.
Hosted-live Foundation steps that are skipped are not live proof.
Exact-head CI on PR103/106/111/113 does not authorize or prove production deployment.
